MossyDell_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.
MossyDell_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.

MossyDell_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

MossyDell_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
MossyDell_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

MossyDell_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
MossyDell_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
